rows.name: Merck & Co.
rows.thesis: Steady large-cap pharma with a growing pipeline and a reasonable valuation; it holds up when the market falls.
rows.risks: Keytruda's patent expiry later this decade and US drug pricing policy.

rows.name: Nucor
rows.thesis: Low-cost US steel producer with a strong balance sheet that benefits from tariffs and infrastructure demand.
rows.risks: Steel prices falling if the economy slows.

rows.name: Targa Resources
rows.thesis: Permian natural gas gathering and processing; fee-based cash flows and a growing dividend.
rows.risks: Lower Permian drilling activity if oil prices fall.

rows.name: CrowdStrike
rows.thesis: Leading cybersecurity platform with durable recurring-revenue growth; the acquisitions add AI security features.
rows.risks: Its high valuation is exposed to further selling of growth stocks.

rows.name: Marathon Petroleum
rows.thesis: Beat on third-quarter earnings, raised its dividend 10% and buys back a lot of stock; refiner margins are still healthy.
rows.risks: Refiner profit margins falling from peak levels.

rows.name: DuPont
rows.thesis: The simpler post-split DuPont is re-rating on better margins and cash flow; the stock is near its high.
rows.risks: Weak industrial demand and costs from PFAS lawsuits.

rows.name: Viatris
rows.thesis: Cheap generic drug maker that keeps reaching new highs as its turnaround and buybacks progress.
rows.risks: Generic price pressure and problems at its manufacturing plants.

rows.name: Valero Energy
rows.thesis: Efficient refiner that returns a lot of cash to shareholders; strong export and renewable diesel businesses.
rows.risks: The same refiner-margin risk as MPC; together they are a concentrated bet.

rows.name: NetApp
rows.thesis: Storage demand from AI data work and a shift to flash storage; reasonably valued with good cash flow.
rows.risks: Caught in the hardware selloff ahead of late-November earnings.

rows.name: Keysight Technologies
rows.thesis: Test and measurement equipment for AI, 6G and defense; it fell with tech without any company news.
rows.risks: Mid-to-late November earnings could confirm slowing orders.

rows.name: Morgan Stanley
rows.thesis: Wealth management gives steady fees, and recovering deal-making helps the investment bank.
rows.risks: Weak markets reduce trading and advisory revenue.

rows.name: Fortinet
rows.thesis: Q3 revenue grew 20% and billings guidance was raised for the third time this year; the 37% one-month drop looks like selling with the rest of tech, not a broken company.
rows.risks: Firewall upgrade cycle slowing and the stock staying weak below its 200-day average.

rows.name: Humana
rows.thesis: Much better 2027 Medicare star ratings support earnings recovering from the depressed 2026 base by 2028; a defensive name that doesn't depend on oil prices or AI spending.
rows.risks: Medicare Advantage medical costs rising, or worse government payment rates.

rows.name: Illumina, Inc.
rows.thesis: Raised its full-year revenue and earnings forecasts, with strong free cash flow, despite missing on Q3 revenue.
rows.risks: Weak China sales and slower lab spending.
